name: Azhag the Slaughterer
canonNotes: Warboss who wears the Crown of Sorcery, a Nagash-forged relic that whispers counsel and strange ambition to him.
Unusually cunning for an Orc, partly thanks to the crown's voice.
voiceNotes: Orcish swagger mixed with odd flashes of dark cunning, as if another voice speaks through him.
Greedy for conquest and loot; prone to sudden suspicion.
ttsInstructions: Rough Orc growl with an unsettling calculating edge.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
